import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MOD = 1000000007;

    static class ModInt {
        int val;

        ModInt(long v) {
            v %= MOD;
            if (v < 0) v += MOD;
            val = (int) v;
        }

        static int modInv(int a, int m) {
            int g = m, r = a, x = 0, y = 1;
            while (r != 0) {
                int q = g / r;
                g %= r;
                int temp = g;
                g = r;
                r = temp;
                x -= q * y;
                temp = x;
                x = y;
                y = temp;
            }
            if (x < 0) x += m;
            return x;
        }

        ModInt(int v) {
            val = v % MOD;
            if (val < 0) val += MOD;
        }

        ModInt() {
            val = 0;
        }

        int toInt() {
            return val;
        }

        ModInt add(ModInt o) {
            val += o.val;
            if (val >= MOD) val -= MOD;
            return this;
        }

        ModInt sub(ModInt o) {
            val -= o.val;
            if (val < 0) val += MOD;
            return this;
        }

        ModInt mul(ModInt o) {
            val = (int) ((long) val * o.val % MOD);
            return this;
        }

        ModInt div(ModInt o) {
            return mul(o.inv());
        }

        ModInt add(long v) {
            val = (int) ((val + v) % MOD);
            if (val < 0) val += MOD;
            return this;
        }

        ModInt sub(long v) {
            val = (int) ((val - v) % MOD);
            if (val < 0) val += MOD;
            return this;
        }

        ModInt mul(long v) {
            val = (int) ((long) val * v % MOD);
            if (val < 0) val += MOD;
            return this;
        }

        ModInt inv() {
            return new ModInt(modInv(val, MOD));
        }

        ModInt pow(long p) {
            assert p >= 0;
            ModInt a = new ModInt(val);
            ModInt res = new ModInt(1);
            while (p > 0) {
                if ((p & 1) == 1) res.mul(a);
                a.mul(a);
                p >>= 1;
            }
            return res;
        }

        boolean equals(ModInt o) {
            return val == o.val;
        }

        ModInt inc() {
            val = (val == MOD - 1) ? 0 : val + 1;
            return this;
        }

        ModInt dec() {
            val = (val == 0) ? MOD - 1 : val - 1;
            return this;
        }

        ModInt negate() {
            return val != 0 ? new ModInt(MOD - val) : new ModInt(0);
        }
    }

    static final int N_MAX = 7;
    static int N;
    static ModInt[][] prob = new ModInt[N_MAX][N_MAX];

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        N = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());

        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
            for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
                int p = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
                prob[i][j] = new ModInt(p).div(new ModInt(100));
            }
        }

        List<List<Integer>> masksByCnt = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i <= N_MAX; i++) {
            masksByCnt.add(new ArrayList<>());
        }

        int[] idxMap = new int[1 << N];
        Arrays.fill(idxMap, -1);

        for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << N); mask++) {
            int cnt = Integer.bitCount(mask);
            idxMap[mask] = masksByCnt.get(cnt).size();
            masksByCnt.get(cnt).add(mask);
        }

        Map<Long, ModInt> dp = new HashMap<>();
        dp.put(1L << idxMap[0], new ModInt(1));

        for (int left = 0; left < N; left++) {
            Map<Long, ModInt> ndp = new HashMap<>();

            for (int cur = 0; cur < 1 << N; cur++) {
                ModInt prod = new ModInt(1);
                for (int right = 0; right < N; right++) {
                    if (((cur >> right) & 1) == 1) {
                        prod.mul(prob[left][right]);
                    } else {
                        ModInt one = new ModInt(1);
                        ModInt p = prob[left][right];
                        ModInt comp = new ModInt(1);
                        comp.sub(p.val);
                        prod.mul(comp);
                    }
                }

                for (Map.Entry<Long, ModInt> entry : dp.entrySet()) {
                    long state = entry.getKey();
                    ModInt curP = entry.getValue();

                    long nst = 0;
                    for (int mask : masksByCnt.get(left)) {
                        if (((state >> idxMap[mask]) & 1) == 1) {
                            for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
                                if ((((cur >> i) & 1) == 1) && (((mask >> i) & 1) == 0)) {
                                    nst |= 1L << idxMap[mask | (1 << i)];
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    ModInt newP = new ModInt(curP.val);
                    newP.mul(prod.val);
                    ndp.put(nst, addOrReplace(ndp, nst, newP));
                }
            }
            dp = ndp;
        }

        ModInt ans = new ModInt(0);
        long fullMask = (1L << N) - 1;
        for (Map.Entry<Long, ModInt> entry : dp.entrySet()) {
            long state = entry.getKey();
            ModInt p = entry.getValue();
            if (((state >> idxMap[(int) fullMask]) & 1) == 1) {
                ans.add(p.val);
            }
        }
        System.out.println(ans.toInt());
    }

    static ModInt addOrReplace(Map<Long, ModInt> map, long key, ModInt value) {
        if (map.containsKey(key)) {
            ModInt existing = map.get(key);
            existing.add(value.val);
            return existing;
        } else {
            return new ModInt(value.val);
        }
    }
}
